thread_title: What do you love about Quillnote?

posts.author: pb_writes
posts.text: What do you love about Quillnote? Trying to decide whether to renew and would like to hear the good side for once.

posts.author: night_owl_notes
posts.text: The templates. I built a literature review template years ago and still use it daily.

posts.author: maria_k
posts.text: Backlinks changed how I write. I find old ideas I had forgotten about.

posts.author: lena.v
posts.text: The daily note is the only habit that has ever stuck for me.

posts.author: gardenofnotes
posts.text: Clean design, no clutter, and the mobile app is quick when sync behaves.

posts.author: night_owl_notes
posts.text: Also the export to PDF is the best of any notes app I have tried.

posts.author: tomasz_r
posts.text: Even after we cancelled I kept a personal plan just for the templates.
